item.title: MetaMask Agent Wallet's Guard Mode Checks Four Things. The approve() Amount Isn't One of Them
item.description: MetaMask Agent Wallet launched publicly on August 6, 2026. Its security model is a real, well-built pipeline. I read the pipeline against one specific pattern — an ERC20 approve that grants more than the task needs — and it still goes through.
